summary: version_compare is the older name of the version test, comparing version strings with loose, strict, semver/semantic or pep440 rules.
questions: What's the difference between version and version_compare?

answer_card.title: version_compare test
answer_card.answer_md: `version_compare` is the old name of `version`. Same schemes: `loose` (default), `strict`, `semver`/`semantic`, `pep440` (2.14+).
